name: com.reclabs.smart.colliders
description: Automatic collider generation and editing for static and skinned meshes (3D and 2D): primitive fitting, convex hulls, decomposition into compound colliders (V-HACD, CoACD, built-in), Scene view authoring, batch processing and baking.

samples.description: Menu Tools > Smart Colliders > Samples > Create Demo Scene: builds a rover (Per Mesh), an L-shaped arch (Decompose) and a sprite (2D) ready to generate, refine and bake.
